job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced GenAI Engineer to join our team at Brigosha Technologies. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in artificial intelligence and machine learning, with the ability to design and develop innovative solutions.



Roles and Responsibility




Design and develop AI and ML models to solve complex problems.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI and ML into existing systems.


Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines and architectures.


Conduct research and stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in AI and ML.


Work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs and develop tailored solutions.


Ensure high-quality code and adhere to industry standards and best practices.




Job Requirements




Strong foundation in computer science, mathematics, and statistics.


Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.


Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.


Strong understanding of software development principles and methodologies.


Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively with stakeholders.
